about.title: About COIREA
about.mission_text: COIREA exists to support organizations in becoming regenerative forces—entities that create more value than they consume, that contribute to the healing of our world while thriving economically.

clarity.title: Clarity of Purpose
clarity.description: We help organizations discover and align with their deeper purpose, creating coherence between values and actions.

coherence.title: Coherence
coherence.description: We foster alignment between individual, team, and organizational systems for maximum effectiveness.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.description: We champion authentic leadership and transparent practices that build trust and sustainable relationships.

human_centered.title: Human-Centered Systems
human_centered.description: We design organizational structures that honor human dignity and enable people to thrive.

reciprocity.title: Reciprocity
reciprocity.description: We believe in mutually beneficial relationships with all stakeholders and the living systems we're part of.

evolution.title: Brave Evolution
evolution.description: We support leaders in making courageous choices that serve the greater good and future generations.

offerings.title: We Don't Offer Quick Fixes —
offerings.subtitle: We Support Deep Evolution
offerings.description: True transformation requires more than surface-level changes. We work with organizations ready to evolve their fundamental structures, cultures, and ways of being.

assessment.title: Organizational Health Assessment
assessment.description: Comprehensive evaluation of your organization's current state and transformation readiness.

retreat.title: Team Transformation Retreats
retreat.description: Immersive experiences designed to catalyze deep shifts in consciousness and collaboration.

program.title: Long-term Evolution Programs
program.description: Multi-phase journeys supporting sustained organizational transformation over 6-24 months.

tools.title: Free Diagnostic Tools
tools.description: Discover where your organization stands and identify key areas for conscious transformation.
tools.scanner_description: A comprehensive assessment to evaluate your organization's readiness for transformation.

journey.title: Begin Your Transformation Journey
journey.description: Every transformation begins with a single step. Let's explore how we can support your organization's evolution.
journey.form_description: Help us understand your current situation and transformation goals.

footer.description: Supporting purpose-driven organizations in their evolution toward regenerative business models.
